tldr: Permanent-survival effects remain identified under unbounded follow-up, yet censoring can make their estimation irregular. The proposed focal object is the joint frontier for cure-contrast absolute risk and globally honest expected interval length when both cure fractions may vanish. It keeps the complete marked observation law, arbitrary normalized Borel susceptible subdensities, and a public exponential censor law. The research question demands evaluated finite-sample rates, the rarity-dependent critical logarithm, attaining point procedures, and one interval that adapts to every rarity subclass without receiving the radius. The zero-cure theorem isolates the honesty cost, while known-censoring tangent closure supplies the regular positive-cure benchmark.
gap: Regular cure-mixture inference uses an integrable full-support representation; extreme-value methods instead restrict latency tails and often extrapolate beyond a censor endpoint.
